rows.quote: Outcome data on CHD and myocardial infarction from the CARDIoGRAMplusC4D 1000 Genomes project have been contributed by CARDIoGRAMplusC4D investigators and have been downloaded from www.CARDIOGRAMPLUSC4D.ORG, including 60 801 cases and 123 504 controls.15
rows.reference_quote: Nikpay M, Goel A, Won HH, Hall LM, Willenborg C, Kanoni S, Saleheen D, Kyriakou T, Nelson CP, Hopewell JC, et al. A comprehensive 1000 Genomes–based genome-wide association meta-analysis of coronary artery disease. Nat Genet. 2015;47:1121–1130. doi: 10.1038/ng.3396
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the CARDIoGRAMplusC4D 1000 Genomes outcome data (60 801 cases, 123 504 controls) to reference 15, whose DOI is the source identifier of one dictionary row only; the counts agree with that row.

rows.quote: Furthermore, outcome data on myocardial infarction were also retrieved from the FinnGen R10 populations study release, including 26 060 cases and 360 108 controls.16
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the FinnGen R10 study release.

Reread after the gate failure. The row's one passage describes the instruments as coming from the complete cohort, with the discovery and replication meta-analysis statistic used for some proteins, and gives 54 219 individuals with reference 14. No sentence holds a release label, accession or alias of one dictionary row, the stated sample size is no candidate row's, and reference 14 supports several candidate releases. A descriptive phrase is not an identifier under the rules, so the row is left unresolved.
